study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Simplified Bishop score (SBS) on admission for labor
simplified Bishop score (SBS) on admission for labor
outcome: Completion of first stage of labor
finding: An unfavorable SBS on admission for labor (≤ 5) was associated with a decreased likelihood of vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that an unfavorable simplified Bishop score on admission for labor is associated with a decreased likelihood of having a vaginal delivery.
